items.text: Vietnam Human Rights Day is a stark reminder of the cruel repression that remains commonplace in Vietnam–where journalists and activists like Le Huu Minh Tuan continue to be brutally punished for speaking out against human rights abuses. This treatment is unjust and wrong. I will continue to fight until Le Huu Minh Tuan and all prisoners of conscience are free.
I am saddened to hear of President Biden’s cancer diagnosis. My prayers are with him and his family during this difficult time. I am wishing him strength, resilience, and a full recovery.

The Big, Ugly Bill threatens Medicaid coverage for over 2 million California residents and 600,000 Californians could lose their Affordable Care Act coverage. Premiums will skyrocket by thousands of dollars for hard-working families across the state. That’s not OK with me. I’ll keep fighting to make sure California families have quality, affordable, and accessible care. https://t.co/aeoitMxZ14

President Trump's big, ugly budget will increase health care premiums for Californians by over $100 every month. I’m working hard to protect high quality, affordable medical care for all Americans. https://t.co/e8iqP6fV7n

President Trump's budget threatens health care coverage for over 80,000 children in our community. That’s not OK with me. I introduced the Keep Kids Covered Act to ensure that every child covered by Medicaid has affordable access to the quality health care they need.

Congressional Republicans passed legislation that eliminates the Affordable Care Act’s premium tax credits, spiking costs for Californians by $2,500 annually. That’s unacceptable. I’m proud to cosponsor the Protecting Healthcare and Lowering Costs Act to permanently extend the ACA’s premium tax credits and defend affordable health care access for our community members. https://t.co/png1qiIOAZ

Access to essential healthcare is non-negotiable for all California families – and that includes quality at-home, telehealth, and hospice care. It was great speaking with dedicated folks from the National Alliance for Care at Home about how I can support their mission to make high-quality home care affordable and accessible for our community members.

When Congressional Republicans passed H.R. 1, they voted to end health care premium tax credits through the Affordable Care Act. Now, Californians are about to see their premiums spike by over 10% – that’s unacceptable. https://t.co/XlEbnv9WLB

I joined my colleagues in calling on House leadership to permanently extend the ACA tax credits, and I cosponsored the Protecting Healthcare and Lowering Costs Act to put more money back in your pocket and preserve your access to high-quality, affordable health care.

Here’s what the end of the Affordable Care Act’s premium tax credits would mean for our SoCal community: 
💰Premiums will spike by over $2,500 annually
📈Health care costs will rise for 35,000 people
🏥9,500 CA-45 residents will lose health insurance

I cosponsored the Protecting Healthcare and Lowering Costs Act to permanently extend the enhanced premium tax credit because no family should be priced out of essential care.

Without ACA tax credits:
– Premiums spike $2,500+
– 35,000 in SoCal see higher costs
– 9,500 in CA-45 lose insurance
We need a bipartisan deal that protects health care and lowers costs for California families.

Clinics like Central City Health Care in Garden Grove play a vital role in keeping our community safe and healthy. Because of Republican cuts, these clinics may face staff shortages, increased wait times, and fewer patients. That’s unacceptable. We need a budget that protects these essential clinics.

1.6 million Veterans rely on Medicaid.
1.3 million on Medicare.
President Trump would rather let their costs skyrocket than reach a bipartisan compromise.

Need help during the shutdown?
Whether it’s benefits, pay, or health coverage, my office is here to help.
📞 (714) 960-6483
🌐 https://t.co/8O1sSBQXMD https://t.co/Y4bhbddmfR

House Republicans would rather shut down the federal government than protect health care for over 40,000 CA-45 residents who rely on Medicaid or the ACA’s enhanced premium tax credit to stay healthy. That’s unacceptable.

The end of the enhanced premium tax credit will raise health care costs for families across California – regardless of whether you’re covered by the Affordable Care Act. To find out how your costs might spike, visit: https://t.co/dhue75yZi7

This week, nearly 10,000 of our neighbors will receive notices that their health care costs are going up. Families could be forced to choose between health insurance, paying their utility bills, or buying groceries. I'm dedicated to fixing this broken system and lowering health care costs for our community. https://t.co/7K000f7Jge

Our troops can't count on their next paycheck. Health insurance premiums are doubling, tripling, and even quadrupling. Veterans and seniors await critical updates about their benefits. This shut down must end now. I’m here in Washington making sure your voices are heard, and I’ll work with anyone – Republican or Democrat – to ensure our government works for you.

This week, Covered California will be sending out notices that health care premiums are about to rise for over 35,000 folks in CA-45. Republican or Democrat, health issues don't discriminate — that's why I'm fighting hard to ensure that EVERY member of our community can afford the care they need to thrive. https://t.co/7K000f7Jge

If Congress doesn't act, CA-45 families will see their health insurance costs more than double. That’s thousands more per year that Orange County residents will have to spend on health care while grocery, gas, and utility prices are already on the rise. Speaker Johnson must call the House back into session, open the government and address this crisis. https://t.co/3FhFNszE0A

Cuts to health care leave tens of thousands of patients in Southern California out in the cold. Planned Parenthood is a lifeline for thousands of patients, but funding cuts mean less care and longer wait times. I was proud to stand with Planned Parenthood in Orange County to defend health care and demand better for our community.

Cuts to health care will leave tens of thousands of patients with nowhere to go for care. That's unacceptable. I stood with patients and providers at Planned Parenthood to demand better for our community. https://t.co/0WinDMIdh3

80% of Californians are worried about rising health care costs. This isn’t a partisan issue – Democrat or Republican, affordable health care is non-negotiable for every California family. https://t.co/4G2fiXYuRC

Covered California’s open enrollment period is just around the corner. Because of cuts to affordable health care by Congressional Republicans, your health care costs might rise. Visit https://t.co/dhue75zx7F to find out how much your costs might be going up.
